title: Foreman
tagline: Staffing agency for AI workers, open source
summary: Staffing agency for AI workers. Describe a job in plain English and Foreman designs a worker for it. You read every step it takes, approve sensitive actions, and replace it if it underdelivers. Open source, bring your own keys.
note: An agent harness for recurring work. Runs resume after a crash, tools are granted per worker, every model call is metered, and a person approves risky steps. Open source.
caption: A job spec becomes a worker, assembled block by block, and walks through the approval gates.
